_comment: 英文触发词表。description 是技能唯一的触发依据（Agent Skills spec），原 when_to_use 非规范字段多数客户端读不到，故把触发词并入 description。此表提供英文侧触发词，中文侧由 when_to_use 自动抽取。新增技能时在此登记并跑 scripts/migrate_frontmatter.py --check。

triggers.qa-agent-testing: AI agent, LLM, or chatbot testing — tool-calling behavior, hallucination rates, prompt injection defense, role-boundary keeping, and memory consistency
triggers.qa-ai-blindspot-compensation: compensating for known blind spots in AI-generated test cases — timing dependencies, concurrency conflicts, resource contention, state accumulation, data consistency, and third-party integration differences
triggers.qa-ai-context-engineering: building a structured context package so an LLM has full business, functional, and technical context before generating test cases
triggers.qa-ai-output-critique: critiquing AI-generated test cases across completeness, correctness, executability, risk coverage, conformance, consistency, traceability, and redundancy
triggers.qa-ai-prompt-strategy: choosing or optimizing the prompt that drives test case generation — role definition, output format constraints, and injection of prior analysis results
triggers.qa-api-testing: API testing for REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, SOAP, and webhook endpoints — contract validation, auth bypass, idempotency, timeout and retry behavior, and backward compatibility
triggers.qa-boundary-deep-dive: boundary value analysis across input, state, time, and resource dimensions — finding edge cases that the obvious boundary list misses
triggers.qa-bug-lifecycle: bug and defect management — severity and priority grading, status workflow and SLA, defect metrics, and trend analysis
triggers.qa-bug-reporting: writing a bug report an engineer can reproduce without asking follow-up questions, or fixing reports that got rejected
triggers.qa-bug-root-cause-analysis: root cause analysis for recurring or escaped defects using 5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, and causal diagrams, plus escaped-defect analysis
triggers.qa-ci-cd-testing: integrating tests into a CI/CD pipeline — layered quality gates, fast commit-stage tests, and release blocking criteria
triggers.qa-code-review-for-test: reviewing a PR or code diff from a testing perspective to determine regression scope and high-risk areas
triggers.qa-combination-strategy: parameter and environment combination explosion — orthogonal arrays, pairwise testing, decision tables, and combinatorial test reduction
triggers.qa-critical-thinking: challenging unstated assumptions in a requirement to surface scenarios that nobody considered
triggers.qa-domain-modeling: state machine, data flow, and service dependency modeling to expose implicit business rules and system boundaries
triggers.qa-execution-observation: observing test execution across six signal channels — functional behavior, API responses, logs, UI rendering, data consistency, and performance
triggers.qa-expert-review: final human-style review of AI-generated test cases before shipping, sampling for business validity, scenario completeness, and executability
triggers.qa-exploratory-testing: exploratory testing with a charter — scenario roaming, role play, failure-path probing, benchmark comparison, and session notes
triggers.qa-heuristic-checklist: heuristic checklists and testing points by feature type — login, payment, search, cart, import/export, approval, notification, and permissions
triggers.qa-input-validation: checking whether the user's test request contains enough context before any test design work starts
triggers.qa-mobile-testing: mobile testing for iOS and Android apps, H5 pages, and mini programs — interruptions, weak network, background/foreground switching, permissions, and device compatibility
triggers.qa-output-validation: final anti-hallucination verification of generated test cases — fact checking, cross-case consistency, executability, and requirement traceability
triggers.qa-quality-metrics: test quality metrics and dashboards — process, result, efficiency, and health indicators for management reporting
triggers.qa-question-framework: structured questions to ask product and engineering to unblock test design — requirements research, boundary confirmation, rule mining, and technical detail follow-up
triggers.qa-regression-testing: regression scope and strategy for a release — smoke, core, and full regression selected by change impact and risk when time is short
triggers.qa-release-risk-governance: release readiness assessment — canary rollout, rollback planning, release risk evaluation, and production monitoring thresholds
triggers.qa-req-deconstruction: deconstructing a vague requirement into testable dimensions — inputs, operations, states, outputs, and rules — plus mining implied and derived requirements
triggers.qa-requirement-review: reviewing a PRD or requirement document for completeness, clarity, consistency, testability, and feasibility before test design starts
triggers.qa-retrospective: test retrospectives and post-incident review — defect trends, escaped-defect analysis, efficiency data, and turning lessons into reusable assets
triggers.qa-risk-intuition: identifying areas that look simple but carry high risk — frequently changed modules, third-party dependencies, money and security paths, and historical defect hotspots
triggers.qa-scenario-tree: building a test scenario tree — main path, alternate path, exception path, and business-rule scenarios with traceable IDs
triggers.qa-shift-left: shifting testing left into requirements and development — requirement testability review, test design during development, and technical design review
triggers.qa-shift-right: shifting testing right into production — APM and log monitoring, synthetic probing, canary verification, and chaos engineering
triggers.qa-specialized-testing: specialized non-functional testing — performance and load and stress testing, OWASP security testing, and cross-browser compatibility
triggers.qa-stakeholder-communication: communicating test findings to engineers, product managers, and management using role-tailored templates and escalation strategy
triggers.qa-state-transition: state machine testing — legal, illegal, boundary, and concurrent state transitions, and data consistency across them
triggers.qa-team-coaching: coaching and enabling a QA team — pairing, knowledge sharing, checklist and template creation, and onboarding new members
triggers.qa-tech-debt-management: test automation and test asset technical debt — interest versus principal, flaky test triage, and staged repayment plans
triggers.qa-tech-selection: evaluating and selecting QA tooling — automation frameworks, performance tools, and management platforms — and planning the migration
triggers.qa-test-automation-arch: test automation architecture — Page Object, layered test design, keyword-driven and data-driven frameworks, and data management
triggers.qa-test-case-design: designing structured test cases with P0-P3 prioritization, coverage strategy, conformance to the standard format, and requirement traceability
triggers.qa-test-data-engineering: bulk test data generation, production data masking and anonymization, data compliance, and data factory architecture
triggers.qa-test-env-data: test environment setup and stability troubleshooting, multi-environment strategy, and day-to-day test data preparation
triggers.qa-test-estimation: estimating test effort in person-days with complexity grading, historical baselines, risk coefficients, and confidence ranges
triggers.qa-test-leadership: QA team leadership — goal setting, KPI definition, performance review, hiring interviews, and capability models
triggers.qa-test-reporting: writing test reports for different audiences — daily reports for the team, weekly reports for the PM, and quality summaries for management
triggers.qa-test-skills: generating structured test cases from a PRD, Word, PDF, or URL through an orchestrated workflow covering functional, boundary, combination, and regression testing
triggers.qa-test-strategy-design: test strategy for a new project or iteration — scope, layered approach, entry and exit criteria, risk matrix, and tooling
triggers.qa-testability-advocacy: assessing and improving system testability — controllability, observability, isolatability, automability, and diagnosability
